sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: Unique-values dropdown (📊): added "Editor info - Active for" and "Editor info - Active since" sections for the `annotations` pageType's own `editorActivity()` synthetic "Active for"/"Active since" columns (decomposed from the "Editor" column's membership tooltip). Neither existed before this — see org/column-unique-value-drop-down-menu.org's "Analysis results" suggestion #2. Also registered `editorActivity()`'s "Active start date"/"Active end date" synthetic columns in `_dateExprColumnNames()`, so they now get the full "Date info" family (Precision/Decade/Month/Year/Weekday) for free, the same way `eventParts()`'s "Event-Date" and `dateTimeParts`-fed columns already do. New: `isEditorActiveForCol`/`isEditorActiveSinceCol` column-name gates, `editorActiveForValueCounts`/`editorActiveSinceValueCounts` Maps (added to the `_uniqDropDataCache` bundle), `editoractivefor:`/`editoractivesince:` compound structure-modes in `_cellMatchesStructureMode()`, and `_highlightEditorActiveForMatch()`/`_highlightEditorActiveSinceMatch()`.
